definitions.gloss: to cry out; to wail; to scream and cry
definitions.explanation: To cry loudly while screaming or shouting, expressing extreme grief, pain, or distress. A compound verb combining 泣く (to cry) and 叫ぶ (to shout).

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{泣|な}き⟦{叫|さけ}んで→叫ぶ：02108_sakebu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}え→耐える：12087_taeru⟧きれず{泣|な}き⟦{叫|さけ}んだ→叫ぶ：02108_sakebu⟧。
examples.english: Unable to bear the pain, I cried out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{亡|な}くした→亡くす：30483_nakusu⟧⟦{少女|しょうじょ}→少女：03233_shoujo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{泣|な}き{叫|さけ}び⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{崩|くず}れ⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: The girl who had lost her mother collapsed to the ground, wailing.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound verb that expresses more intense emotion than ⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧ alone. Often used in dramatic or literary descriptions of grief, pain, or desperation.

Conjugates as a godan verb ending in ぶ: {泣|な}き⟦{叫|さけ}ばない→叫ぶ：02108_sakebu⟧, {泣|な}き⟦{叫|さけ}びます→叫ぶ：02108_sakebu⟧, {泣|な}き⟦{叫|さけ}んで→叫ぶ：02108_sakebu⟧, etc.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧: to cry — general, less intense
- ⟦{号泣|ごうきゅう}する→号泣する：18377_goukyuusuru⟧: to bawl, cry loudly — emphasizes volume of crying
- ⟦{喚|わめ}く→喚く：05345_wameku⟧: to scream, yell — emphasizes the shouting aspect
